Editorial plans for two chapters of the long sample (「シン発狂典【ギュ論】」, 147 pp.), used by
tests/test_editorial_plan.py.

- `before/`: the chapters as printed, written back as plans (section sizes measured from the PDF, the one
  device each chapter had, no density or chapter-end plan).
- `after/`: the same material re-planned under long.criticism. Section contents, sources and devices come from
  the printed text and its reference numbers ([n] → src-00nn); nothing is added that the chapter does not contain.
